stories.title: "My gf, randomly while we’re watching tv: 'that horse has scoliosis'"
stories.summary: A viewer watching the period drama Outlander with their girlfriend paused on an emotional embrace in the foreground—completely upstaged by a horse in the pasture behind them sporting an absurdly severe swayback. The post blew past 290K likes as users marveled at the horse's dramatic spinal curve.
